# Scripted effects take no parameters in 1.19.3 (decision E1): a call sets zin_arg_<name> temporary variables first.
# sight codes: north 1, south 2, seas 3, east 4, centre 5, any 0.

zin_sun_add_gala_counsel = {
	GAA = {
		add_to_variable = { zin_gala_counsel = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_gala_counsel min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
}

zin_sun_add_old_lords = {
	GAA = {
		add_to_variable = { zin_gala_old_lords = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = zin_gala_old_lords min = 0 max = 5 }
	}
}

zin_sun_add_concord = {
	add_to_variable = { global.zin_sun_concord = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_sun_concord min = 0 max = 100 }
}

zin_sun_add_clarity = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				AND = {
					has_global_flag = zin_mirror_stilled
					check_variable = { zin_arg_value > 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		add_to_variable = { global.zin_mirror_clarity = zin_arg_value }
		clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_mirror_clarity min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
}

zin_sun_spend_clarity = {
	subtract_from_variable = { global.zin_mirror_clarity = zin_arg_value }
	clamp_variable = { var = global.zin_mirror_clarity min = 0 max = 100 }
}

zin_sun_startup = {
	set_global_flag = zin_sun_noon_council
	set_variable = { global.zin_sun_concord = 40 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_mirror_clarity = 60 }
	set_variable = { global.zin_sun_league_peace_days = 0 }
	GAA = {
		set_variable = { zin_gala_counsel = 50 }
		set_variable = { zin_gala_old_lords = 1 }
		set_variable = { zin_sun_last_sight = 0 }
	}
	LIG = { set_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president }
}

zin_sun_mirror_vision = {
	set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 5 }
			}
			zin_sun_sight_true_centre = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 2 }
			}
			zin_sun_sight_true_south = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 1 }
			}
			zin_sun_sight_true_north = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 3 }
			}
			zin_sun_sight_true_seas = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 0 }
			OR = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_arg_sight = 4 }
			}
			zin_sun_sight_true_east = yes
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 4 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_cost = 25 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_gala_true_traces }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_cost = 15 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 0 } }
		multiply_temp_variable = { zin_sun_cost = 0.5 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_sun_cost }
	zin_sun_spend_clarity = yes
	set_variable = { zin_sun_last_sight = zin_sun_seen }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 1 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_sun_sight_north days = 730 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 2 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_sun_sight_south days = 730 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 3 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_sun_sight_seas days = 730 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 4 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_sun_sight_east days = 730 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_sun_seen = 5 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_sun_sight_centre days = 730 }
	}
	country_event = { id = zin_sun.10 }
}

zin_sun_heed_warning = {

		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_sun_heeded_north days = 730 }
		add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_sun_heeded_north days = 365 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { zin_sun_warned_sight = 2 } }
		set_country_flag = { flag = zin_sun_heeded_south days = 730 }

zin_sun_form_noon_league = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_sun_noon_league }
			is_in_faction = no
		}
		create_faction_from_template = zin_faction_noon_league
		set_global_flag = zin_sun_noon_league
		set_variable = { global.zin_sun_league_peace_days = 0 }
		news_event = { id = zin_sun.30 }
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes
					original_tag = GAA
				}
				NOT = { is_in_faction_with = PREV }
				is_in_faction = no
			}
			country_event = { id = zin_sun.31 }
		}
	}
}

zin_sun_lorien_rides = {
	set_global_flag = zin_lorien_rides
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_refusal_lifted } }
		zin_diplo_lift_refusal = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_gala_ready_to_ride }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 1 }
		zin_sun_add_old_lords = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_war_with = ZOL } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = global.zin_eindil_host
				var:global.zin_eindil_host = { has_war_with = ZOL }
			}
			var:global.zin_eindil_host = {
				GAA = { add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = PREV enemy = ZOL hostility_reason = asked_to_join } }
			}
		}
		else = {
			ZOL = {
				every_enemy_country = {
					set_variable = { zin_sun_mid_states = 0 }
					every_controlled_state = {
						limit = { zin_is_region_middle_lands = yes }
						add_to_variable = { PREV.zin_sun_mid_states = 1 }
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { any_country = { has_war_with = ZOL } }
				random_country = {
					limit = {
						has_war_with = ZOL
						NOT = { original_tag = GAA }
						NOT = {
							any_other_country = {
								has_war_with = ZOL
								NOT = { original_tag = GAA }
								check_variable = { zin_sun_mid_states > PREV.zin_sun_mid_states }
							}
						}
					}
					GAA = { add_to_war = { targeted_alliance = PREV enemy = ZOL hostility_reason = asked_to_join } }
				}
			}
			else = {
				set_country_flag = { flag = zin_story_war days = 1 }
				declare_war_on = { target = ZOL type = annex_everything }
			}
		}
	}
	add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_sun_kings_ride days = 30 }
	set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_stand_days = zin_gala_old_lords }
	multiply_temp_variable = { zin_sun_stand_days = 7 }
	add_to_temp_variable = { zin_sun_stand_days = 14 }
	clamp_temp_variable = { var = zin_sun_stand_days min = 14 max = 49 }
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_war_with = ZOL
			GAA = {
				check_variable = { zin_gala_old_lords > -0.01 }
				check_variable = { zin_gala_old_lords < 1.99 }
			}
		}
		add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_sun_old_powers_stand_1 days = zin_sun_stand_days }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_war_with = ZOL
			GAA = {
				check_variable = { zin_gala_old_lords > 1.99 }
				check_variable = { zin_gala_old_lords < 3.99 }
			}
		}
		add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_sun_old_powers_stand_2 days = zin_sun_stand_days }
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = {
			has_war_with = ZOL
			GAA = {
				check_variable = { zin_gala_old_lords > 3.99 }
				check_variable = { zin_gala_old_lords < 5.99 }
			}
		}
		add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_sun_old_powers_stand_3 days = zin_sun_stand_days }
	}
	news_event = { id = zin_sun.40 }
}

zin_sun_lorien_falls = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_lorien_dead } }
		set_global_flag = zin_lorien_dead
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_character = zin_lorien
				has_country_leader = { character = zin_lorien ruling_only = yes }
			}
			kill_country_leader = yes
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = {
				has_character = zin_lorien
				NOT = { has_country_leader = { character = zin_lorien ruling_only = yes } }
			}
			retire_character = zin_lorien
		}
		GAA = {
			set_variable = { zin_gala_old_lords = 0 }
			multiply_variable = { zin_gala_counsel = 0.5 }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_sun_king_fallen days = 730 }
			country_event = { id = zin_sun.42 days = 14 }
		}
		multiply_variable = { global.zin_mirror_clarity = 0.5 }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 5 }
		zin_sun_add_concord = yes
		every_country = {
			limit = { zin_sun_is_elven_realm = yes }
			add_timed_idea = { idea = zin_sun_mourning days = 180 }
		}
	}
}

zin_sun_refresh_foreign_hold = {
	clr_global_flag = zin_sun_foreign_hold
	every_state = {
		limit = {
			zin_is_region_lands_of_the_sun = yes
			controller = {
				NOT = { zin_sun_is_lands_of_the_sun_country = yes }
				any_enemy_country = {
					OR = {
						zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes
						original_tag = GAA
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_global_flag = zin_sun_foreign_hold
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_sun_foreign_hold } }
		clr_global_flag = zin_sun_concord_rallied
	}
}

zin_sun_refresh_president = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president }
		clr_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president
	}
	if = {
		limit = { country_exists = LIG }
		LIG = { set_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president }
	}
	else = {
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes
				NOT = {
					any_other_country = {
						zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes
						check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
					}
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { any_country = { zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes } } }
		clr_global_flag = zin_sun_noon_council
	}
}

zin_sun_refresh_mirror = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_mirror_stilled }
		every_state = {
			limit = {
				zin_is_site_gala = yes
				controller = { zin_sun_is_elven_realm = yes }
			}
			clr_global_flag = zin_mirror_stilled
		}
	}
}

zin_sun_monthly = {
	zin_sun_refresh_president = yes
	zin_sun_refresh_foreign_hold = yes
	zin_sun_refresh_mirror = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				any_country = {
					zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes
					any_enemy_country = { zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.1 }
		zin_sun_add_concord = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { zin_sun_counsel_grows = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 0.2 }
		zin_sun_add_gala_counsel = yes
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_sun_regain = 2 }
	if = {
		limit = { GAA = { has_idea = zin_gala_still_water_spirit } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { zin_sun_regain = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = zin_sun_regain }
	zin_sun_add_clarity = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = zin_sun_noon_league }
		random_country = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president }
			if = {
				limit = { has_war = no }
				add_to_variable = { global.zin_sun_league_peace_days = 30 }
			}
			else = { set_variable = { global.zin_sun_league_peace_days = 0 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.zin_sun_league_peace_days > 729.99 } }
			random_country = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = zin_sun_council_president is_faction_leader = yes }
				dismantle_faction = yes
			}
			clr_global_flag = zin_sun_noon_league
			set_variable = { global.zin_sun_league_peace_days = 0 }
		}
	}
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_sun_is_lands_of_the_sun_country = yes }
		mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
	}
}

zin_sun_on_declare_war = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes
			FROM = { zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes }
		}
		set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = -10 }
		zin_sun_add_concord = yes
	}
}

zin_sun_on_capitulation = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = GAA
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_lorien_rides }
			NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_lorien_dead }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = LIG
				LIG = {
					NOT = { original_tag = GAA }
					NOT = { tag = FROM }
					NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
					has_capitulated = no
				}
			}
			become_exiled_in = { target = LIG legitimacy = 60 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				any_country = {
					zin_sun_is_elven_realm = yes
					NOT = { original_tag = GAA }
					NOT = { tag = FROM }
					NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
					has_capitulated = no
				}
			}
			random_country = {
				limit = {
					zin_sun_is_elven_realm = yes
					NOT = { original_tag = GAA }
					NOT = { tag = FROM }
					NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
					has_capitulated = no
					NOT = {
						any_other_country = {
							zin_sun_is_elven_realm = yes
							NOT = { original_tag = GAA }
							NOT = { tag = FROM }
							NOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
							has_capitulated = no
							check_variable = { num_owned_states > PREV.num_owned_states }
						}
					}
				}
				PREV = { become_exiled_in = { target = PREV legitimacy = 60 } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				country_exists = MAG
				MAG = { NOT = { tag = FROM } }
			}
			become_exiled_in = { target = MAG legitimacy = 60 }
		}
	}
}

zin_sun_on_state_control = {
	FROM.FROM = {
		if = {
			limit = { zin_is_site_gala = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { ROOT = { zin_sun_is_elven_realm = no } }
				if = {
					limit = { GAA = { has_country_flag = zin_gala_courtyard_guarded } }
					GAA = { country_event = { id = zin_sun.36 days = 30 } }
				}
				else = {
					set_global_flag = zin_mirror_stilled
					GAA = { country_event = { id = zin_sun.35 } }
					ROOT = { country_event = { id = zin_sun.35 } }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { ROOT = { zin_sun_is_elven_realm = yes } }
				clr_global_flag = zin_mirror_stilled
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				zin_is_region_lands_of_the_sun = yes
				ROOT = { zin_sun_is_lands_of_the_sun_country = no }
				FROM = { zin_sun_is_lands_of_the_sun_country = yes }
				ROOT = { has_war_with = FROM }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					FROM = {
						OR = {
							zin_sun_is_sunhot_realm = yes
							original_tag = GAA
						}
					}
				}
				set_global_flag = zin_sun_foreign_hold
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = zin_sun_concord_rallied } }
				set_global_flag = zin_sun_concord_rallied
				set_temp_variable = { zin_arg_value = 10 }
				zin_sun_add_concord = yes
			}
		}
	}
}
